[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mareave, Seconded: The Barrens">A commission to build a trading post in Mareave in the region of Icarion. To establish a trade of salt for beef with Beoraidh. Fully funded!
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Icarion, Mareave, as per the '''[[A_knock_at_the_door#Salt_and_Beef|A knock at the door]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Spring 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 wains of weirwood
* 30 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Beoraidh_Trading_Post}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the Beoraidh Trading Post has had the following effects:
*Increases the income of the [[Shepherd of the Southern Herd]] by 10 crowns each season
*Increases the income of the [[Shepherd of the Great Herd]] in Skarsind by 5 crowns each season
*Secures trade between the Unshackled and Beoraidh
